stem.text: A car travels anticlockwise along a horizontal circular road of radius $12\,\text{m}$, as shown.
The car takes a time of $4.0\,\text{s}$ to move from position P to position Q.

stem.alt: Circle representing a road, with point P on the right side of the circle and point Q at the bottom. A dashed radius labelled 12 m joins the centre to P. An arrow beside the circle is labelled direction of travel of car, and the road is labelled road.

stem.text: What is the magnitude of the average velocity of the car for the journey from P to Q?
